text: 1.Objective: Students in this program receive systematical training in theories, research, design and manufacturing methods of traditional Chinese medicine and natural medicine. Graduates work in such fields as manufacturing, identification and analysis of TCM, as well as pharmacology and biotechnology.2.Degree Requirements: Students in this program spend the first 2 years studying the basic sciences, biology and chemistry courses. In the first semester of the 3rd Year of their undergraduate study, student must choose from different areas of concentration: 1. traditional Chinese pharmaceuticals, 2. analysis of Chinese material medica, 3. biotechnology of Chinese materia medica. Upon graduation, students must have completed core courses, lab courses, practicum and thesis writing.3.Course Offering: Basics: Core Advanced Mathematics Linear Algebra Probability & Statistics Physics College English Law Basics Computer Basics Programming Language Biology & Chemistry: Inorganic Chemistry Analytical Chemistry Organic Chemistry Physical Chemistry Biochemistry Microbiology Core: Pharmacology Spectroscopic Analysis Introduction to TCM Traditional Chinese Pharmacy Prescription of TCM Processing of Chinese Material Medica Medicinal Chemistry of Natural Products Human Anatomical Physiology Pharmacology of Chinese Material Medica Pharmacognosy Pharmaceutical Botany Analysis of Chinese Materia Medica Traditional Chinese Pharmaceutics Pharmaceutical Management
